module.ninocraft.fullbright.desc: Makes the night as bright as day.
module.ninocraft.zoom.desc: Zoom in while holding the zoom key.
module.ninocraft.nofog.desc: Removes fog so you can see far away.
module.ninocraft.fireless.desc: Hides fire and screen overlays when burning.
module.ninocraft.keystrokes.desc: Shows your WASD, mouse and space keys on screen.
module.ninocraft.weather.desc: Turns off rain and thunder on the client.
module.ninocraft.timechanger.desc: Sets a fixed time of day on the client.
